newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen A index sags at noon, B market closed.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen A index sags at noon, B market closed.

text.p: A series of weak interim company results dragged Shenzhen's domestic currency A share index lower at midday on Monday, analysts said.
The hard currency B share market was closed for a day in line with a public holiday in neighbouring Hong Kong.
The A share index fell 10.75 points, or 2.86 percent, to 364.45 on turnover of 1.6 billion yuan.
"The A share market is weak anyway and disappointing interim results on Friday exacerbated that," said an analyst at China Guotai Securities.
Most of the 22 A share companies that released first half results after the market closed on Friday reported lower net profits.
Of the four companies with B shares that reported results on Friday, three posted lower net profits compared with the year-ago period.
The three companies were Shenzhen Shenbao nndustrial Co Ltd, Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd and Shenzhen Properties & Resources Development (Group) Ltd.
"I don't think this will hurt the B share market because most of the attention is focused on newly-listed shares," the Guotai analyst said.
Listed firms must release their 1997 first-half reports by the end of August.
In the A share market, Shenbao, which has A and B shares, dropped to its 10 percent limit-down level, reaching 7.43 yuan, to become one of the session's sharpest losers.
